quote: it is further ORDERED, as provided in Sixth Circuit Rule 14, that the previous decision and judgment of this court are vacated, the mandate is stayed and the case is restored to the docket as a pending appeal.
note: E is itself the en banc order (granting rehearing en banc, same docket 95-3794), not an en banc opinion; it vacates the panel decision P (104 F.3d 880).

quote: IT IS ORDERED that this appeal will be reheard en banc. The panel's opinion is VACATED.
note: E (30 F.4th 1333) is the en banc order granting rehearing in 21-10550, not an en banc merits opinion; it vacates the unpublished panel opinion P.

quote: Because this case presents a number of issues of exceptional importance, we ordered that it be heard en banc pursuant to Circuit Rule 35-3. Sarei v. Rio Tinto, PLC, 499 F.3d 923 (9th Cir.2007).
note: P (499 F.3d 923) is the order granting rehearing en banc, not the panel opinion (487 F.3d 1193); E cites P as that order; E never says the panel opinion was vacated (P order only bars citing it).

quote: That opinion, in which I wholeheartedly concurred, was withdrawn by the en banc court on December 29, 2006. See Comer v. Stewart, 471 F.3d 1359 (9th Cir.2006).
note: Only Pregerson's dissent in E says P (463 F.3d 934) was withdrawn, citing the en banc order 471 F.3d 1359 (not in item); per curiam majority silent; order file 1409175 is a 2002 abeyance order predating P and does not touch P.

quote: E: following the issuance of the division's opinion in Abrams I and the vacation of that opinion in Abrams II, the case was argued to the full court sitting en banc. O: the petition for rehearing en banc is granted and the opinion and judgment of July 10, 1995 are hereby vacated.
note: DC Court of Appeals division opinion P (662 A.2d 867, Abrams I) vacated by en banc grant order O (674 A.2d 499, Abrams II); E names Abrams II (the order) as the vacating act.
Different case: P is Franco v. State (No. 288, 2006); E is Parkcentral Global v. Brown (No. 288, 2010), Delaware Supreme Court sitting en banc as a normal full bench; no mention of P.

quote: See opinion on Intervenor's Motion to Keconsider and Vacate Stay, Greylock. Broadcasting Co. v. United States and Federal Communications Comm'n, 1956, 97 U.S.App.D.C. 414, 231 F.2d 748.
note: P (231 F.2d 748) is a panel ruling denying a motion to vacate a stay, not a merits decision; E is the first-instance en banc merits decision (affirmed) on consolidated petitions; E cites P only as the stay ruling.

quote: Upon the vote of a majority of nonrecused active judges, it is ordered that this case be reheard en banc pursuant to Federal Rule of Appellate Procedure 35(a) and Circuit Rule 35-3. The three-judge panel opinion is vacated.
note: Order O (983 F.3d 1077) vacates P (971 F.3d 965); en banc E (997 F.3d 916) does not say vacated, cites P for its facts and says the panel properly followed Romero-Ruiz, and remands to the panel.

quote: A majority of the justices of the Court voted to deny the motion for en banc reconsideration.
note: E is an opinion dissenting from denial of en banc reconsideration (Jennings, J.); no en banc rehearing took place; panel memorandum opinion P stands.

quote: In this bobtailed en banc proceeding, the majority has filed essentially the same opinion that was filed by the majority in the original panel's consideration of this matter. Rutan v. Republican Party of Illinois, 848 F.2d 1396 (7th Cir.1988).
note: E's majority never says P was vacated or reinstated; only P's own head matter says Rehearing Granted Aug. 17, 1988, Judgment and opinion vacated; Ripple's dissent in E says the en banc majority refiled essentially the panel opinion.
